pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING 11.2.1 INTENSIVE READING: DIGITAL STORIES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.2: Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading: Digital Stories

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading: Digital Stories. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What role do pictures in a book or cover play in a story?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify words, phrases and proverbs from a digital text
2. create mental images from viewed, heard or read text
3. answer direct and inferential questions correctly for comprehension

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 11.2.1 INTENSIVE READING: DIGITAL STORIES
This lesson teaches Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading: Digital Stories for Grade 6 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify words, phrases and proverbs from a digital text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. create mental images from viewed, heard or read text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. answer direct and inferential questions correctly for comprehension
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading: Digital Stories using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading: Digital Stories above.
2. Explain Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading: Digital Stories to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading: Digital Stories.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading: Digital Stories with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading: Digital Stories important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What role do pictures in a book or cover play in a story?
2. How are digital stories different from story books?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify words, phrases and proverbs from a digital text
2. create mental images from viewed, heard or read text
3. answer direct and inferential questions correctly for comprehension
